R05.quote: `Import#receipt` (app/models/import.rb:68). ... the downloaded receipt CSV has an empty `doi` column.

R09.quote: Under 7.1 defaults, the exports page raises whenever an expired export renders on a cache miss, because `expires_in` goes negative (exports/_export.html.erb:26).
R09.reason: The report limits the raise to a cache miss, but with the default adopted it also raises on a cache hit; the report also rates the change medium where the label says high.

R11.quote: The digest now covers the reader's local day, not the UTC day that the UI promises

R14.quote: `retry_on wait: :exponentially_longer` (citation_enrichment_job.rb:7) raises only when a retry fires; rename to `:polynomially_longer`

R17.reason: The report rates it low, while the label is medium because hidden failures and the choice between :none and :rescuable need a decision.

R19.quote: `Citation::Provider#initialize` default argument (app/models/citation/provider.rb:13). ... It fails at runtime inside `CitationEnrichmentJob`, not at boot.

R21.quote: the notebook settings form resubmits `slug` (notebooks/_form.html.erb:13, notebooks_controller.rb:40, `attr_readonly :slug` at notebook.rb:8). Every settings save would raise.

R23.quote: `select_rows` returns `Date` objects, so `Date.iso8601(day)` (notebook.rb:40) raises `TypeError` on the activity page.

R25.quote: `stale?(etag:, last_modified:)` (export_downloads_controller.rb:11) would ignore If-Modified-Since. Harmless here.
R25.reason: The report calls it harmless for this app, while the label is high because some conditional GETs change from 200 to 304 without an error.

otherGems.quote: actiontext 8.1 no longer ships Trix itself; it depends on the `action_text-trix` gem.

otherFindings.summary: Action Text `to_plain_text` numbers ordered lists differently and drops script/style text, changing export contents (HIGH-7).
The Astana time zone now maps to Asia/Almaty (UTC+5), shifting times for users stored with "Astana" (HIGH-8).
The built-in Sidekiq adapter is deprecated in 8.1, and the move to Sidekiq 7.3.3+ affects Redis error handling, the sadd guard and argument checks (MEDIUM-2).
Trix now comes from the action_text-trix gem, so Trix 2 CSS and a UMD actiontext.js would load alongside the vendored Trix 1.3.5 (MEDIUM-4).
The 7.1 default switches the sanitizer vendor to HTML5, changing what Action Text allows (listed under MEDIUM-5).
